proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you provide a small, shareable Parquet sample (or a script that generates equivalent data with CREATE/INSERT) that still triggers the SIGFPE when the progress bar is enabled, together with the exact commands you run to enable the progress bar (e.g. the PRAGMA or CLI flags) and the full crash backtrace shown when running with the progress bar on? With that minimal reproducer I can follow the same steps locally; the provided SQL references external parquet files that weren’t included.
proposal.rationale: The report shows a crash and supplies the SQL script, but the failing data (the Parquet files under `../raw_metars` and attached data files) are not provided. Without a small, shareable Parquet sample or a data-generation script, the steps cannot be reproduced to trigger the crash.
